text: ①じゅうじボタンで　もじに　あわせ　Ａボタンを　おすと　えらばれます。

structure.jp: ①じゅうじボタンで　もじに　あわせ
structure.en: ① line up on a character with the D-pad
and when you press the A Button

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing follows. おすと = 'when you press'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This ending says the thing has the action done to it. えらばれます = 'it gets selected'.

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short, without ます, joins to the next action like 'and'. あわせ = 'line it up, and'.
